version.changelog:
AgentRef skill 1.0.1

- Added OpenClaw integration metadata, including homepage URL and required environment variable (AGENTREF_API_KEY).
- Introduced guidance to prefer dedicated, minimally-scoped API keys for safer operation.
- Clarified recommendations around credential usage, including details for inspection-only and affiliate-only flows.
- No changes to functionality or endpoints; documentation improvements only.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed AgentRef REST API helper that can perform sensitive merchant actions only with an API key and repeated confirmation guardrails.

dimensions.detail: Network access to AgentRef and an API key are expected for this REST API skill; users should use least-privilege keys because merchant writes can affect live business state.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown reference material only, with no executable install scripts or dependency setup; it declares AGENTREF_API_KEY as the required credential.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to curated AgentRef endpoints, require GET /api/v1/me first, prohibit invented endpoints, prefer safe reads, and require clear confirmation before state-changing actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, local indexing, privilege escalation, or local credential-store access is present; the skill explicitly says not to print, log, echo, or persist the raw API key.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The purpose is coherent with the capabilities: it documents AgentRef merchant and affiliate REST workflows, including reads plus account, program, affiliate, flag, and payout writes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent use your AgentRef account. Prefer a dedicated, least-privilege AGENTREF_API_KEY, start with read-only scopes for inspection, and grant write scopes only when you want confirmed changes to programs, affiliates, flags, or payouts.
llm.findings:
[TM1] expected: The DELETE /api/v1/programs/{id} endpoint is sensitive, but it is documented as an archive action, labeled destructive write, and explicitly requires user confirmation; this does not show tool-parameter abuse in the artifact.
[EA2] expected: The autoApproveAffiliates text is an API field for program creation or update, not an instruction for autonomous approval; the surrounding instructions require explicit confirmation before creating or updating programs.
[EA2] expected: The duplicate finding points to the same program-write surface, which is purpose-aligned and disclosed with read-first and confirmation requirements.
